params.instruction: Draw a semicircle figure in TikZ. Pixel coords (origin top-left, y down; convert y by flipping, e.g. use scale 0.01 and y_tikz = (413 - y_px)). Key points: B=(60,347), O=(305,346) centre, D=(546,347), C=(336,65), A=(457,165) on the arc, E=(292,110) approx where line BC crosses the arc (E lies on segment BC). Radius of semicircle about 236 px, center O. Draw: the diameter BD (solid segment), the upper semicircular arc from B to D through A and E-region (arc centre O radius 236). Segments: B-C (passing through E), C-A (tangent to the arc at A), A-B, A-O. Right angle marks: at C between CB and CA, and at A between AO and AC (small squares, about 11-13 px). Labels: B at lower-left of B, O below O, D lower-right of D, C above C, A upper-right of A, E upper-left of E. Solid thin-to-medium black lines, dots at O (small filled dot). Keep figure proportions; compile standalone.
